overview: TradeNest Naturals is a specialized FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter supplying dehydrated rose petal powder. Sourced from selected Indian roses, the raw material undergoes a precise six-step production process including cleaning, controlled drying, grinding, and sieving. The resulting fine botanical powder preserves a natural floral aroma, vibrant pinkish-red hue, and consistent physical texture for global manufacturing applications.

Our dehydrated rose petal powder features a uniform 80 to 100 mesh size with moisture maintained below 8 percent. Built for bulk procurement, we support international food and personal care brands with flexible packaging, OEM specifications, and comprehensive export documentation. Every production batch adheres to rigorous quality inspection protocols, delivering dependable raw material stability across commercial supply chains.
highlights: Controlled dehydration preserving natural pinkish-red color
Extended 24-month shelf life under recommended storage
Manufactured through a standard six-step processing cycle
packaging: 25 kg multi-wall paper bags or HDPE containers
Small private-label pouches and retail jars
Custom bulk and retail packaging options on request

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for rose petal powder?
faqs.a: The standard minimum order quantity is 5 kg for bulk supply and private label orders.

faqs.q: Do you supply product samples prior to placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide product samples on request to allow industrial buyers to evaluate mesh size, aroma, and color.

faqs.q: Can the mesh size be customized for our formulation?
faqs.a: Yes, custom mesh sizes and tailored sieving profiles can be provided upon request.

faqs.q: What packaging configurations are available for export?
faqs.a: We offer 25 kg bags or HDPE containers, 5 to 10 kg bags, and custom private-label pouches or jars.

faqs.q: What is the shelf life and proper storage condition?
faqs.a: The product has a shelf life of 24 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Do you offer export documentation and OEM private labeling?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide complete export documentation support along with end-to-end OEM and private label manufacturing services.
